shortDescription: Executes a command on a remote Windows node

options.name: _raw_params
options.description: The C(win_command) module takes a free form command to run. This is mutually exclusive with the C(cmd) and C(argv) options. There is no parameter actually named '_raw_params'. See the examples!

options.name: argv
options.description: A list that contains the executable and arguments to run. The module will attempt to quote the arguments specified based on the L(Win32 C command-line argument rules,https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/c-language/parsing-c-command-line-arguments). Not all applications use the same quoting rules so the escaping may not work, for those scenarios use C(cmd) instead.

options.name: chdir
options.description: Set the specified path as the current working directory before executing a command.

options.name: cmd
options.description: The command and arguments to run. This is mutually exclusive with the C(_raw_params) and C(argv) options.

options.name: creates
options.description: A path or path filter pattern; when the referenced path exists on the target host, the task will be skipped.

options.name: output_encoding_override
options.description: This option overrides the encoding of stdout/stderr output. You can use this option when you need to run a command which ignore the console's codepage. You should only need to use this option in very rare circumstances. This value can be any valid encoding C(Name) based on the output of C([System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncodings()). See U(https://docs.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.encoding.getencodings).

options.name: removes
options.description: A path or path filter pattern; when the referenced path B(does not) exist on the target host, the task will be skipped.

options.name: stdin
options.description: Set the stdin of the command directly to the specified value.
